title: SoftwareFactoryReviewResult
description: Structured verdict from the software-factory-review skill (CAP-6 independent review). Parsed by factory/graph/review_graph.py from the claude CLI's --json-schema structured_output.

findings.description: Issues found in the implementation, against the plan's acceptance criteria or against technical quality and this repo's agent instructions. Empty array = clean pass.

location.description: Where the finding applies -- a file path, optionally with a line/section reference.

description.description: What is wrong and why it matters.
